$comment: L2H-02-CTX-RESIDUAL: residual ctx-menu ledger rows. Verify-first facts: UpdateTOC opens #updatetoc-dialog (openUpdateTocDialog, editor.js:9332/9950); TextAlignment is a table-gated submenu (toggleCtxSubmenu, editor.js:9831) whose TextAlignCenter child sets td inline text-align (applyCellTextAlign, editor.js:10267/10320); Insert-tab #btn-header inserts <header class=page-header> directly (editor.js:1274); the WO table-settings surface is the insert-tab Table actions button -> #table-ops-dialog (openTableOps, editor.js:2871) — no ctx-menu item exists for it (right-panel #rp-table-advanced routes to borders-dialog instead, editor.js:7261/7797); clipboard rows observe the system clipboard itself (runner clipboard assertion, _boot grants read/write permissions) -> ctx copy/cut promoted 2026-11-07 via the L2M-04 clipboard fallback.

ctx.justify.note: ledger ctx.justify — WO surface elsewhere: ribbon data-cmd=justifyFull (not in the WO ctx menu); execCommand('justifyFull') justifies the block under the caret (same proven contract as home-format.json justifyfull)

ctx.text-alignment.note: ledger ctx.text-alignment — TextAlignment is a data-showif=table submenu header (toggleCtxSubmenu keeps the menu open, editor.js:9831); the TextAlignCenter child applies inline text-align:center on the selected td (applyCellTextAlign, editor.js:10267/10320); computed-style reads the td the selection sits in

ctx.edit-header.note: ledger ctx.edit-header — WO surface elsewhere: insert-tab header button (data-cmd=insertHeader) inserts <header class=page-header> as #editor's first child on first press (editor.js:1274-1295; not in the WO ctx menu)

ctx.update-entire-table.note: ledger ctx.update-entire-table — ctx UpdateTOC opens #updatetoc-dialog (openUpdateTocDialog, editor.js:9332/9950); its Update button (confirmUpdateTocDialog, editor.js:9336) inserts <nav class=toc> when absent and runs refreshToc — the whole-table update op

ctx.update-table-of-contents.note: ledger ctx.update-table-of-contents — same UpdateTOC ctx row opens the Update Table of Contents dialog (openUpdateTocDialog, editor.js:9332/9950)

ctx.update-page-numbers-only.note: ledger ctx.update-page-numbers-only — the updatetoc-dialog's #toc-update select carries the 'Update page numbers only' option value=pages (index.html:2403); confirmUpdateTocDialog branches choice===pages (editor.js:9337/9350)

ctx.table-advanced-settings.note: ledger ctx.table-advanced-settings — WO surface elsewhere per the ledger (table-ops-dialog): no ctx-menu item exists (index.html ctx census); the reachable table-settings surface is the insert-tab Table actions button -> #table-ops-dialog (openTableOps, editor.js:2871); the right-panel #rp-table-advanced link routes to borders-dialog instead (editor.js:7261/7797)

ctx.copy.note: ledger ctx.copy PROMOTED 2026-11-07 — the ctx Copy handler (editor.js) copies the placeCaret selection to the system clipboard (native execCommand copy; L2M-04 clipboard fallback writes the selection via navigator.clipboard.writeText when the synthetic click lacks user activation); the clipboard assertion reads the payload back — placeCaret selects the leading 'Will' of the fixture h1

ctx.paste.note: ctx Paste goes through richPaste/navigator.clipboard.readText — seedClipboard fills the headless system clipboard

ctx.cut.note: ledger ctx.cut PROMOTED 2026-11-07 — execCommand cut needs transient user activation (the synthetic ctx click has none), so the L2M-04 clipboard fallback in the Cut handler writes the placeCaret selection ('Will', fixture h1) to the system clipboard via navigator.clipboard.writeText and deletes it (execCommand delete); the clipboard assertion pins the copied payload

ctx.copy-hyperlink-address.note: ledger ctx.copy-hyperlink-address promoted — in the link-at-caret pre the data-showif=link row is visible and the handler (editor.js:9932-9937) resolves linkEl.closest("#editor a[href]") from the preserved selection anchor and writes linkEl.href (https://example.com/, the fixture link) to the system clipboard; _boot grants clipboard-read/write permissions so the runner's clipboard assertion reads the payload back (probe-verified roundtrip)

ctx.frame-advanced-settings.note: FrameSettings on a plain image falls through to openImageAltDialog (#image-alt-dialog); vector/equation path is the equation-settings row
